The report contains the results of compliance audits of various government departments in Tamil Nadu for the year ended March 2022. It includes three specific area compliance audits related to the preparedness of fire services, provision of housing to SC/ST beneficiaries, and implementation of welfare schemes for differently abled persons. It also contains 12 compliance audit paragraphs on issues like bid rigging, violation of tender conditions, avoidable/unfruitful expenditure, blocking of funds, and idling of assets.

The report contains the results of compliance audits of various government departments in Tamil Nadu for the year ended March 2022. It includes three specific area compliance audits related to the preparedness of fire services, provision of housing to SC/ST beneficiaries, and implementation of welfare schemes for differently abled persons. It also contains 12 compliance audit paragraphs on issues like bid rigging, violation of tender conditions, avoidable/unfruitful expenditure, blocking of funds, and idling of assets.
